reviews.title: Ramiro Blaz
reviews.text: This app when it’s functioning properly is actually pretty good. That’s when it working as it should. I’ve had a couple issues with it. Last year I named some recordings and had some technical issues and contacted support. They responded I believe once. For a couple weeks or more no support was provided. I eventually figured out the issue  myself. A couple months ago after I renewed I noticed after making numerous recordings that the app said I have no recordings. I’ve contacted support now twice and have not received a response. This company has the absolute worst customer support I have experienced. I’ve paid for a service I can’t use or rather the app tells me it’s recording the calls but never actually saves them to my account. They disappear. Support has done absolutely nothing to respond to my trouble tickets let alone resolve the issue. I want my recordings I’ve paid for with this service. After writing this review I’ve downgrade from two stars to one. Simply explaining this leaves me frustrated and frankly angry that a company doesn’t care about its customers enough to even respond when contacted with technical issues such as mine. Piss poor service.
